categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu Shengnuo Biotech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the pharmaceutical manufacturing industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of peptide raw materials and formulations. The company also provides pharmaceutical research services, customized peptide product manufacturing, and technology transfer services related to peptide drugs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed advanced core technologies in peptide synthesis and modification, including long-chain peptide coupling, difficult sequence coupling, multi-peptide fragment coupling, single sulfur ring peptide production, multi-disulfide bond peptide synthesis, carbon ring peptide production, and side-chain modifications such as PEGylation and fatty acid modification. Production strictly follows GMP standards with integrated R&D and manufacturing platforms supporting small to large-scale peptide drug production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international pharmaceutical companies and research institutions engaged in innovative peptide drug development. The company serves markets in major therapeutic areas such as diabetes, obesity, oncology, immune system diseases, cardiovascular diseases, rare diseases, and reproductive health. End markets span hospitals, healthcare providers, and pharmaceutical manufacturers in China, the US, Europe, Korea, Russia, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Chengdu, Sichuan Province. It has expanded its market reach internationally, with product registrations and sales in the United States, European Union, South Korea, Russia, and Southeast Asia. The company also maintains overseas marketing and distribution channels through partnerships and agents.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chengdu Shengnuo Biotech operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on peptide raw material synthesis, formulation production, and contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) services. It provides integrated services from drug substance synthesis to finished dosage forms and technology transfer, supporting both innovative and generic peptide drug manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven product development with a strategic focus on peptide drugs for major diseases such as diabetes, obesity, oncology, immune disorders, and reproductive health. It invests heavily in R&D, expanding its peptide drug pipeline, enhancing CDMO capabilities, and accelerating capacity expansion projects. Collaborations with academic institutions and international partners aim to strengthen technology platforms and develop new peptide applications, including in the health and beauty sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through multiple streams including sales of peptide raw materials and formulations, fees from pharmaceutical research services, customized peptide product manufacturing contracts, and technology transfer agreements. The company employs direct sales, agency sales, and distributor/promoter models domestically and internationally to commercialize its products and services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chengdu Shengnuo Biotech is positioned as one of the leading domestic peptide drug R&D and manufacturing enterprises in China, with strong competitive advantages in peptide synthesis technology and integrated production capabilities. It competes with other domestic and international peptide drug manufacturers and CDMO service providers, leveraging its extensive patent portfolio, quality certifications, and broad product pipeline to maintain a leading market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 456 million, representing a 4.84% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 50 million, a decrease of 28.88% compared to the previous year, mainly due to increased external R&D collaborations. Total assets grew by 25.25% to RMB 1.65 billion, and R&D investment increased significantly to 11.06% of revenue, reflecting a strong growth trajectory and commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its proprietary peptide synthesis and modification technologies, comprehensive peptide drug development and manufacturing capabilities, and integrated CDMO services. It offers high-quality, cost-effective, and scalable peptide raw materials and formulations with proven clinical efficacy and regulatory approvals. Its strong R&D pipeline, quality management systems, and strategic partnerships enable it to deliver innovative peptide solutions addressing unmet medical needs in major disease areas.
